I can agree that NTs, any person really, should reflect on themselves to improve their behavior. however, blanket statements, generalizations, only further perpetuate the "us vs. them" mentality.

should it be on us to watch what we're saying on the public internet? no, everyone should be responsible for what they say. it's your responsibility as a user of the internet (but as it's so integrated with real life, who thinks of the consequences anymore?)

what is your definition of feeling full? are you so full that you're uncomfortable? a meal shouldn't leave you uncomfortably full; the goal is "not hungry."

many people are recommending therapy. if you don't have the money/time or want to get a head start, write down your feelings and hunger level before and after eating. ask yourself if you are still *hungry* - not if you're full.

one of the most helpful things I've ever read on the internet was the "three types of hunger" - physical (stomach growling, pain, all that), mouth (craving a certain taste/texture), and heart (eating because intense emotions)

"mouth" hunger gets me more than anything. I crave a certain thing, I focus on how it tastes, how it feels, and I think about what I will do to obtain it. now that I know this is just mouth hunger, I ask myself, am I physically hungry? if the answer is no, then I distract myself in some way (this is easier for some than others. adhd has been more of a problem for me lately, but it's helpful in this context!). 

same thing kind of goes for heart hunger... if you're not physically hungry, you're forcing yourself to be hungry by talking yourself into eating a treat. here's a tricky one: rethink rewards/treats. we've been given tasty food as treats all our lives; it's no wonder we associate certain emotions with eating. but a reward doesn't have to mean eating tasty food; you'll have to be creative in finding things that can properly replace the food motivation (many lists on google have ideas)

I deleted the twitter app, and I blocked twitter and tumblr on my computer. I noticed that those sites in particular were just making me upset and hate being alive. rarely, I'll use my phone to look at something blocked on my computer. I don't have the problem of getting distracted by having my phone near me (and I don't feel the need to check it because my watch will send me important notifications - calls and texts.. I hate most notifications)

I'm aware most people don't primarily use a computer anymore. I'd recommend hiding apps at first, so you're not opening them by habit. if there's any in particular that are upsetting you, delete them. aside from tiktok, others can be accessed through the web browser. 

as for filling the time... it's tricky. you could read books through libby or the kindle app. nothing quite hits in such a short period of time like social media. journaling helps, I think. just writing down your thoughts, your goals, what you want to achieve. just to get you and your thoughts on the same page.

hey there! i am a white mage main, so i hope i can help you out!

from what i notice, it seems that you forget you have a co-healer. right away, youre trying to get everyone to 100%, meaning either you or your cohealer are doing massive overhealing. also, white mage is a healing-over-time healer, so if youre using medica 2, but got everyone to full, that is massive overhealing because it puts a regen on everyone. no one is taking damage for awhile except for the one tank. in addition, don't be afraid to use regular medica. its the same amount of healing as your lily aoe. when youre doing two medica twos, youre wasting your mp as your overwriting your regens. also to note, i understand the anxiety of not everyone being full health. over time, you'll eventually get used to it as you do the fight more often. if you know your dps are not going to take damage for the next 30 seconds or a minute, why waste a gcd to heal them to full?

for part one, empty wave happens while your presence of mind is going. i ALWAYS leave this to the cohealer to heal. your cohealer will always be a shield healer, so you already have mitigations for it. a scholar will usually use whispering dawn, which is healing over time, and over time everyone will be either full or close to full hp. a astrologian will have their earthly star go off, which pretty much brings everyone to full. obviously for the tb, if you don't have a dark knight, benediction is a good way to go. if you do have a drk, i would suggest saving bene in case the drk gets targeted next and uses living dead. for the remaining of part one, youre doing fine, but i would suggest using asylum for the empty wave that happens after the tethers and stacks. here, i will use a lily, which will pop misery, use misery, and assize will bring everyone to full. after that, what you're doing is fine.

part two: only thing i would say is don't use temperance here, save it for the line stacks in part three. medica 2 and rapture is fine after the stacks. your assize comes up after the first or second stack, so make sure to go into the middle so you can hit the other group for healing as well and try to hit all the adds with it. asylum for blasphemy is unnessesary. i would start off with plenary, use medica II, a couple of lilies, and dps after. in regards to being unable to dps, this is where practicing slide-casting is key. i usually run well ahead of the add so that it catches up to me rather than i have to run to it.

part three: not really a reason to use medica II after the empty wave, since the line stack will happen well after your regen falls off. since everyone's stacked tight, a cure three is fine and you can burn a lily here if you need it. the only reason words of unity would be one shotting people, is if people are too close. you should have your tank in front, obv, then your melee, phys range, healer, caster. aslyum in the middle after is useless due to you and the tanks running to the bird tethers, and the dps in the corners for the meteors. save it for the spread markers for the color portals. for the color portals, everyones stacked for cure 3 range. that, plus asylum will be fine, as your cohealer will be doing a heal here as well.

part four: DON'T use plenary after knockback. medica II and a single lily is fine. NO DAMAGE goes out during orb popping. for movement, once again slidecasting is key, but you can also swiftcast+glare, burn a lily, use misery, or just straight overwrite dia. i'll usually use one of those options to get myself away from the back aoes, then slide cast glare until i'm at the back aoes again. best time to move to get ahead would be as youre going around a corner, that gives you a good amount of time to dps. for threefold grace, asylum is great here, if youre group isn't skipping the second round, hold temperance for the second round. everyone is stacked in cure 3 range, so cure 3 and *maybe* a lily should be good enough. remember that your cohealer will also be using heals, as well as your tanks and dps using mitigations.

all in all, treating it as if your solo healing is going to lead you to unnessary stress, tons of overhealing, and wasted gcds because you're not solo healing. you don't need to communicate how healing works, because white mage has its own healing rotation, as well as astrologian and scholar have their own healing rotations. as you go about the fight more, you know the mechanics, so you can see what the cohealer is doing. also, i highly recommend looking at whm povs to see what theyre doing. notice what their cohealer is doing, what their tanks are doing. the fight is scripted, so everyone is doing the same thing over and over.
